name: PokeKon
blurb: One-day Pokemon collectors' trade show in Tulsa, Oklahoma with vendors, TCG, retro Pokemon, and local artists.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'POKEKON-FEST - ALL POKEMON SHOW - TULSA, OKLAHOMA SUNDAY OCTOBER 25, 2026 | 10:00AM - 5:00PM HILTON DOUBLETREE HOTEL WARREN PLACE'

notes: The seed URL https://www.pokekon.com refuses connections entirely (tried default and msedge channels); the live page is the city-specific http://pokekon.com/Tulsa/ (no https). This is a 1-day Pokemon collectibles trade show (TCG, retro merch, local artists), and its own 'Guests & Attractions' section currently reads 'Guest Announcements Coming Soon', so guests is none-yet rather than none. Some third-party listings (Eventbrite) give the date as Saturday Oct 24; the official site's own text says 'SUNDAY OCTOBER 25, 2026', which is used here as the more authoritative source.
